Label: Geospatial Location
Description: A manufacturer's site: links to its postal address, ZIP code, coordinates and city. Part of the SUDOKN manufacturer data embedded in this graph.

Description: A postal address node; its text is read through hasTextValue. Part of the SUDOKN manufacturer data embedded in this graph.

Label: US Postal Code
Description: A ZIP code node; its value is read through hasIntegerValue, as a string. Part of the SUDOKN manufacturer data embedded in this graph.

Label: Two Dimensional Cartesian Spatial Coordinate Datum
Description: A coordinate node carrying a latitude and a longitude value, as strings. Part of the SUDOKN manufacturer data embedded in this graph.

Label: Business Description
Description: A free-text description of a manufacturer's business; its text is read through hasTextValue. Part of the SUDOKN manufacturer data embedded in this graph.

Label: Web Address
Description: A web address of a manufacturer; the URL is its rdfs:label. Part of the SUDOKN manufacturer data embedded in this graph.

Label: City
Description: A city a manufacturer site is located in. Part of the SUDOKN manufacturer data embedded in this graph.

Label: State
Description: A state or province that cities are located in. Part of the SUDOKN manufacturer data embedded in this graph.

Label: Country
Description: A country that cities and states are located in. Part of the SUDOKN manufacturer data embedded in this graph.

Label: Ownership Status Classifier
Description: An ownership status of a manufacturer, such as minority-owned or veteran-owned. Part of the SUDOKN manufacturer data embedded in this graph.

Label: Climate Model Source
Description: A climate model from the ClimatePub4KG graph (CESM2, GFDL-CM4, GFDL-ESM4), listed here with the software packages it depends on.

Description: Links a product to its product category. The object is a product category IRI used as a node (e.g., sud:TelevisionsProductCategory) and carries no rdf:type.

Label: has Process Capability
Description: Links a manufacturer to a manufacturing process it offers. The capability node is typed with one of 444 SUDOKN capability classes (e.g., sud:CNCMachiningCapability), which are not listed here.

Label: has Material Capability
Description: Links a manufacturer to a material it can process. The capability node is typed with one of 444 SUDOKN capability classes (e.g., sud:AluminumProcessingCapability), which are not listed here.

Label: has Certificate
Description: Links a manufacturer to a certificate it holds. The certificate node is typed with a SUDOKN certificate class (e.g., sud:ISO9001, sud:AS9100), which are not listed here.

Label: supplies To Industry
Description: Links a manufacturer to an industry it supplies. The industry node is typed with one of 84 SUDOKN industry classes (e.g., sud:AerospaceIndustry), which are not listed here.

Label: has Primary NAICS Classifier
Description: Links a manufacturer to its primary NAICS industry code. The node is typed with one of 301 SUDOKN NAICS classes (e.g., sud:NAICS332111.0), which are not listed here.

Label: has Ownership Status Classifier
Description: Links a manufacturer to an ownership status such as minority-owned or veteran-owned.

Label: described By
Description: Links a manufacturer to its business description node.

Label: same As
Description: Links a hardware version to the SUDOKN product it corresponds to. This is the bridge from the software and hardware supply-chain data to the embedded manufacturer data: follow it, then sud:manufactures backwards, to reach the manufacturer.

Label: climate model name
Description: Name of a climate model source (e.g., CESM2).
